sources.title: Government of the Commonwealth of Dominica

capital.evidence_quote: Roseau is the capital and largest urban settlement of the Commonwealth of Dominica

currency.evidence_quote: The Eastern Caribbean Dollar (XCD) is pegged to the USD at 2.70 XCD to 1 USD; USD is widely accepted

timezone.evidence_quote: Dominica operates year-round on Atlantic Standard Time UTC-4 with no seasonal clock changes

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across the Commonwealth is 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Operating frequency of the national electrical grid is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: British standard Type G three-rectangular-pin plugs and older British Type D three-round-pin plugs are used

police.evidence_quote: Dial 999 for emergency police assistance throughout Dominica

sources.title: Dominica China Friendship Hospital Emergency Medical Services

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 999 for emergency medical dispatch and hospital ambulance services

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 999 for fire and rescue emergency operations

general.evidence_quote: 999 coordinates unified emergency dispatch across the island

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Police headquarters in Roseau coordinates visitor safety at +1 767 448-2222

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Dominika 'Doğa Adası' olarak bilinen son derece huzurlu bir eko-turizm cennetidir; standart seyahat önlemleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Dominica, the 'Nature Island', is an exceptionally peaceful eco-tourism sanctuary; exercise normal precautions.
advisory_headline.de: Dominica ist als Naturinsel ein überaus friedliches Ökotourismus-Paradies; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Доминика — исключительно спокойный и живописный зелёный остров; действуют обычные правила.
advisory_headline.es: Dominica, la 'Isla de la Naturaleza', es un santuario ecoturístico sumamente pacífico; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Dominica reach approximately 34.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds measure 60.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Flow and Digicel offer 4G tourist SIMs at Douglas-Charles Airport (DOM) in the northeast. Dominica is home to the Waitukubuli National Trail, the Caribbean's first long-distance hiking trail spanning 115 miles.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Prepaid SIM registration requires valid passport identification

religion.value: Christianity (approx. 80%, predominantly Roman Catholic approx. 61%, Seventh-day Adventist, and Pentecostal)
religion.evidence_quote: Catholicism and Protestantism represent the spiritual core of Dominican village life

festivals.value: World Creole Music Festival (late October), Mas Domnik (Real Mas Carnival), Independence Day Cultural Competitions (Nov 3)
festivals.evidence_quote: The World Creole Music Festival celebrates indigenous musical genres including Cadence-lypso and Bouyon

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Wearing camouflage patterns or military-style gear is strictly illegal for civilians and tourists. Removing plants, boiling lake sulphur rocks, or wildlife from national parks is prohibited. Kalinago Territory in the east is home to the Caribbean's only indigenous Carib reservation.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Wearing camouflage clothing is strictly prohibited under Dominican national security legislation

tipping.value: A 10% service charge is usually included in hotel and restaurant bills; an additional 5-10% tip for helpful nature guides and servers is customary.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% service charge is standard in hospitality invoices
